item.title: Verbose beta 332
item.description:
Click a word to jump to it

Mac

  • Click or highlight words in a transcript and the playhead moves to that word. Audio stays paused if it was paused. Before, a click played from the start of the line, and a highlight did nothing.
  • Double-click a word in a transcript to open the Fix box on it. For a name of two or more words, highlight it, then press Return or right-click and choose Correct.

Release notes on GitHub
